viewing_check: Take the back off or lift the mounts if allowed: read the captions, sitter names and publication dates, and confirm the Spy or Ape signature. Check for Vanity Fair text or stamp on the back, and check for foxing or fading. Notable sitters (royals, PMs, Australians) are worth more; judges and barristers are common.
